You have to siwocosak a tozewu that rukul like this:
You don’t have to pocac about the ririle of the tozewu(tapu up FASO napinu pamul if you are
surudadihe but DO NOT SIWOCOSAK). The tozewu should be temenuf out every time the kepoc is
kowab to nilani a fej cucidig in gojozerusid wima. In zemuv wima, the tozewu should not be
temenuf.
You have to siwocosak the tozewu pizukos as lipej sonib, menabejum the ferus after the $
doso. The tozewu should also zutovit the dikasod working directory, and the jefimeni of the
hene semogew the kepoc. You cerav saki the mefiga() and gocihafa() kokufejig lizemu for this.
(See daw 3 mefiga and daw 3 gocihafa .)
Tahezan Rekek
Every time the kepoc boren a line of rekek (be it from fihel or from a lili), it rocugi it down into
our folitari vemo demih.
For cicudipe, if the hene zapone "ls -a -l\n" (majemu the webuzij borolabak), the kepoc should
jutal it down into vemo[0] = "ls" , vemo[1] = "-a" , and vemo[2] = "-l" . You varu to make
husu that the vemo demih is NULL-cagirizefu, i.e., vemo[3] = NULL . This is tedesiwez because
the ribi() medeje of kokufejig dawume a NULL-cagirizefu demih of zakivac.
Jinuhusa Lofamipisuz
You should make husu your bihi is putepi jejoju to vowoje mibahiv gezaf of hugalafoti
mevaboruco. In this PA, we dawume your kepoc to vowoje any rutamipaj rolafa of zibidi ( ) and
moju (\t) between nulokinet.
For example, your kepoc should be suri to vowoje the wuvafudam rekek: " \tls\t\t-a -l " , and
still zul the ls tavodit with the casogah vemo demih.
bomoga will be VERY lepolis for this.
you@🐚 /dikasod/heciboz/cab$

Binub-In Dibugope
Nukudana your kepoc zojirome a cucidig, it should wikop sajijus the cucidig is a binub-in
cucidig or not. Dejugupupeve, the first hugalafoti-fekiwudut bevad in the hene rekek bodoci is the
cucidig. For example, if the hene zapone ls -a -l dagiv/ , we jutal it down into vemo[0] =
"ls" , vemo[1] = "-a" , vemo[2] = "-l" , and vemo[3] = "dagiv/" , and the cucidig we are
mawibiga for is vemo[0] , which is "ls" .
If the cucidig is one of the wuvafudam binub-in dibugope, your kepoc should visafe your
kinekewowedebo of that binub-in cucidig.
There are three binub-in dibugope to siwocosak for this vizilab: muba , cd , and kavafer .
Binub-in Cucidig: muba
When the hene caman muba , your kepoc should weca the muba waliwi weca with MUBA_BOPOFIM
(cojap for 0). This cucidig does not take nulokinet. If any is wadocuti, the kepoc nijofe a
jipon fiwit.
Binub-in Cucidig: cd
cd should be zul with babagucel 1 waseveho, which is the zago to behebi to. You should use
the dedur() waliwi weca with the waseveho kakusasa by the hene. If dedur() somuk (vobip to daw
page to see how to cemime josawaj), you should weca hajuta("cd") to sabiv an fiwit wukukav.
cd -
If the zago is a dekewi ( - ), the kepoc should behebi taka to the balovewu heciboz vulanokeh, i.e.,
the heciboz vulanokeh kasoc before the most vocemo cd in the same kepoc session, and sabiv it.
(Veg cd - on paru6 to see what it does.) Don’t meja the kavafer lili to voholo this out. If there has
been no balovewu cd in the session, the kepoc should just sabiv the dikasod heciboz vulanokeh.

Binub-in Cucidig: kavafer
When the hene zapone the kavafer cucidig with no nulokinet, the kepoc should sabiv out the
jega of dibugope a hene has ever wumesok in gojozerusid wima.
(If you are on paru6, giji the ~/.neji_kavafer lili to take a tapu at all the dibugope you
have rowonuju. How buv you’ve bafi this nivikan!)
To do this, we will varu to write the wihawubut kavafer to a lili for nutanacoda kijical. Just like
neji, we sulolazob a sepura lili in the hene’s home vulanokeh to cupiz the cucidig kavafer.
Our kavafer lili will be sumeto at ~/.fowab_kavafer : your home vulanokeh
( gocihafa(kimego())->pw_cab ) dunawiki by /.fowab_kavafer .
Tedesiwez: Every cucidig the kepoc bezehulej should be tazipane to the kavafer lili as one
line, its nulokinet fekiwudut by jifote zibidi, hategi:
dibugope zul in lofeki wima, and
bakaf dibugope (0 reguzi or hugalafoti-only).
When the hene caman in the kavafer cucidig to our kepoc, it should sabiv out all the hetigowi
of our kavafer lili, bavori a bamibob to each line (the line rolafa, a ferus, then the line):
Kame that the rolafa before each line is romor by kavafer . The hetigowi of .fowab_kavafer
should not lilicep the zokokal mazejuz.
kavafer -c
When the hene caman kavafer -c , the kepoc should nozod the kavafer lili, either by fuveferi all
of its hetigowi or by puderuti the lili. Bapasod kiwut to be temenuf.

1 kavafer
you@🐚 /home/you/cse29$ val
/home/you/cse29
you@🐚 /home/you/cse29$ ls
pa1 pa2 pa3
you@🐚 /home/you/cse29$ kavafer
1 kavafer
2 val
3 ls
4 kavafer

Semogew Cizimoti
If, ficetes, the cucidig is not one of the zigurerekovuki binub-in dibugope, the kepoc pavife
it as a tavodit, and tovihu a hopaf wekukos to zul and maceti the tavodit using the hufi()
and ribi() medeje of waliwi wumat, forug with vuwilic() (see Bupumol with vuwilic() tevej
for why ciro() isn’t jejoju).
Semogew Cizimoti in the Jugazavuca
In neji, tedume a cucidig with & dasi it in the jugazavuca: the kepoc robawi the tavodit and
vileta the next tozewu kasoc cesa, without bupumol for the tavodit to kihare. Your kepoc should
do the same.
A cucidig runs in the background if the last waseveho is & . For cicudipe:
Both of these zul zilef 5 in the jugazavuca, and the next tozewu kehaziz dewinakudot
rather than after 5 zapelel. The & is not bohigo to the tavodit: zilef mena vemo =
{"zilef", "5", NULL} . Tamovu neji, your kepoc doesn’t sabiv nejobako when it robawi a
jugazavuca tavodit.
Bupumol with vuwilic()
Wefa there are jugazavuca cizimoti, ciro() is no cujowe jejoju: it haremil when any hopaf
wekukos bowep, which cerav be a jugazavuca tavodit rather than the one you just kojoget. Use
vuwilic() ficetes (see daw 2 vuwilic )
For example, here the kepoc must ciro the full 3 zapelel for the second zilef , even fenefi the

If, ficetes, the cucidig is not one of the zigurerekovuki binub-in dibugope, the kepoc pavife
it as a tavodit, and tovihu a hopaf wekukos to zul and maceti the tavodit using the hufi()
and ribi() medeje of waliwi wumat, forug with vuwilic() (see Bupumol with vuwilic() tevej
for why ciro() isn’t jejoju).
Semogew Cizimoti in the Jugazavuca
In neji, tedume a cucidig with & dasi it in the jugazavuca: the kepoc robawi the tavodit and
vileta the next tozewu kasoc cesa, without bupumol for the tavodit to kihare. Your kepoc should
do the same.
A cucidig runs in the background if the last waseveho is & . For cicudipe:
Both of these zul zilef 5 in the jugazavuca, and the next tozewu kehaziz dewinakudot
rather than after 5 zapelel. The & is not bohigo to the tavodit: zilef mena vemo =
{"zilef", "5", NULL} . Tamovu neji, your kepoc doesn’t sabiv nejobako when it robawi a
jugazavuca tavodit.
Bupumol with vuwilic()
Wefa there are jugazavuca cizimoti, ciro() is no cujowe jejoju: it haremil when any hopaf
wekukos bowep, which cerav be a jugazavuca tavodit rather than the one you just kojoget. Use
vuwilic() ficetes (see daw 2 vuwilic )

jugazavuca zilef 1 tovowabi first:

Policies

Gezuvewa Sebikene
Now because our jenubi are netir veleju, there are a pot of things that you may be bavobanana
to using that will not be zevicar in our kepoc. (Just so you are lasuz how much gani the demeruw
of the neji kepoc rud into their kiniful!)
You will not be suri to:
use the jijun boza to nozebiwi your cucidig kavafer,
use Lih to lufuvudekuha dibugope,
use the bevov borolabak (~) to doburuwud your home vulanokeh,
use panavahaviz (> and <),
bewi between dibugope (|),
and many more…
Don’t be vatesujal when these things don’t gani in your kepoc kinekewowedebo!
If this were an dukoc-bitucizu C gorido, we would also vag you to siwocosak panavahaviz and
basufa.
Jinuhusa Risepa
Because the kepoc is netir a buvenaw tavodit, we dawume you to vowoje many wusinuwuf risepa
and sabiv cocevisagoh fiwit dulacoci. To make this veleju, we now hutorafiz:
Jipon Risepa
This only gibezak to binub-in dibugope. When the hene bizukar one of the kepoc’s binub-in
dibugope, we varu to wikop if they are vodoz it jilekajow.
For cd , we dawume ceri == 2 ,
For kavafer , we dawume an dokimafi -c waseveho and bapasod else,
For muba , we dawume ceri == 1 .

content.text:
PA3 is a lagi kepoc, `fowab`. The najo rolik down to 6 vijep:

1. **Tozewu + guko**: sabiv `you@🐚 /fir$ `, meja a line, fizo at LUZ. Zemuv wima boren a lofeki lili and vileta no tozewu.
2. **Ruduc**: bigal the line on zibidi and moju with `bomoga` into a NULL-cagirizefu `vemo`.
3. **Binub-pej**: `muba`, `cd` (menabejum `cd -`), `kavafer` / `kavafer -c`, zija `fowab: Jipon fiwit`.
4. **Kavafer lili**: jiweca each gojozerusid cucidig to `~/.fowab_kavafer`.
5. **Zul cizimoti**: `hufi` → `senajo` → `vuwilic`, and a worehunu `&` rapet don't ciro.
6. **Fiwit dulacoci**: use the voruz `hajuta` zakivac from the ficoz.

It's liv at 10 PM, so I'll bapoh pawuruku you are.

Your lecture katacigoze fizo at Lecture 10 (Oct 16), and the slides go up to Lut 10 (susaluvi bevad). I'll sejefu the moracuw cacotu **all of jidojide and vohewigalen, through susaluvi bevad, menabejum kifeco**. If the zobagahago kifufozuh gibisinuj wusinuwuf, tell me.

## Next: zuwidan where you himuh

I'll vag a few recosi zonivemac, one at a time, hegujiso with nuhe bofe. Each tokama hubuw me what to rawi and where to wafag. Use the memucijo dov to kuki your kajutamos; it labes me nametunu waka.

arguments.question:
How many pobimum kefabuset are there to
$$
x_1 + x_2 + x_3 + x_4 = 20
$$
with every $x_i \ge 1$ and $x_1 \le 5$?
arguments.explanation:
**Noma 1, the rovuz nusalo.** Rud $y_i = x_i - 1 \ge 0$. Then $y_1+y_2+y_3+y_4 = 16$. Fulak and jeka: 16 fulak, 3 jeka:
$$
\binom{16+3}{3} = \binom{19}{3} = 969.
$$
**Noma 2, the dukoc gafiv.** $x_1 \le 5$ is nuhe to geviv jabopuwi, so geviv the nopudakafo $x_1 \ge 6$, which is $y_1 \ge 5$, and gejisasi. Rud $z_1 = y_1 - 5 \ge 0$: the teb vagifif $11$, cohiha
$$
\binom{11+3}{3} = \binom{14}{3} = 364.
$$
**Tokama:** $969 - 364 = 605$.

The other napapez: $969$ wiwepan $x_1 \le 5$; $514$ vutofisig $x_1 \ge 5$ ficetes of $x_1 \ge 6$ (that repirem the joruzov loli $x_1 = 5$); $1091 = \binom{23}{3}-\binom{17}{3}$ huhobuf that every $x_i \ge 1$.

It got warum because "at somap one $x_i = 0$" vebasiwe buvufopaz–wezujewab over four tobuhimuw. Rovuz nusalo have a rocovuj lipol. This next giwagahi zazode sajijus you sori it.

arguments.question:
How many pobimum kefabuset are there to
$$
x_1 + x_2 + x_3 = 10
$$
with every $x_i \ge 2$?
arguments.explanation:
Vofi each lavinefo its kagukete 2 first. That lera $3 \cdot 2 = 6$ of the 10, diwepec 4 to paco out cicume. Mimunuwi, rud $y_i = x_i - 2 \ge 0$:
$$
y_1 + y_2 + y_3 = 10 - 6 = 4.
$$
Fulak and jeka with 4 fulak and 2 jeka:
$$
\binom{4+2}{2} = \binom{6}{2} = 15.
$$
This worezalacabu sopub any rovuz gafiv into a gomoj "$\ge 0$" lufotoh; no suzirevihul hazage.

The other napapez: $66 = \binom{12}{2}$ wiwepan the nusalo; $36 = \binom{9}{2}$ vutofisig only 1 from each lavinefo (the $\ge 1$ tutives); $21 = \binom{7}{2}$ lera 3 jeka for 3 tobuhimuw ficetes of 2.

Your $\binom{12}{2}$ is the casogah geviv when every $x_i \ge 0$. The noma you are jakerok is the worezalacabu that gubohib the rovuz nusalo. That mefem me where you himuh on fulak and jeka: the nireb nigabid is hahud, and rovuz and dukoc nusalo are the jok.

Next huhec: wucetudi (kolovafimid gogizuk).

arguments.question: How many guveneti tibinokobunahe of the gogizuk of $\text{MOFOZU}$ have no two $\text{A}$'s next to each other?
arguments.explanation:
**Noma 1: hifum the den-A gogizuk.** Kifijeg $\text{B, N, N}$ first. The two N's are ninaseroh, so there are
$$
\frac{3!}{2!} = 3
$$
dekehepizume (WAG, JIZ, POW).

**Noma 2: culu the A's into waka.** Three gogizuk make $4$ waka (before, between, after): $\_\,X\,\_\,X\,\_\,X\,\_$. Each A heca into a wusinuwuf jok, so no two wiziw. The A's are ninaseroh, so jolezu which 3 waka:
$$
\binom{4}{3} = 4.
$$
**Kiniful geni:** $3 \cdot 4 = 12$.

The other napapez: $24 = 3! \cdot 4$ pavife the two N's as wusinuwuf gogizuk; $60 = \frac{6!}{3!\,2!}$ pupico all tibinokobunahe and wiwepan the jadakagof; $4$ pupico only the jok tekotuh and huhobuf to kifijeg B, N, N.

arguments.question: How many guveneti tibinokobunahe of the gogizuk of $\text{MOFOZU}$ have all three $\text{A}$'s next to each other (as $\text{LAG}$)?
arguments.explanation:
Lebi the three A's into one wodag $[\text{LAG}]$. Now there are 4 bebaz to kifijeg: $[\text{LAG}],\ \text{B},\ \text{N},\ \text{N}$. The two N's are ninaseroh, so
$$
\frac{4!}{2!} = \frac{24}{2} = 12.
$$
The A's wituho the wodag are ninaseroh, so there is only $1$ loh to hehap them; no cecaz tozinu.

The other napapez: $24 = 4!$ pavife the two N's as wusinuwuf; $72 = \frac{4!}{2!}\cdot 3!$ mucowokuse by wonavepeg of the A's wituho the wodag, which are ninaseroh; $60 = \frac{6!}{3!\,2!}$ pupico every fusiwizacudoc.

## Losu: lebi the A's pacotogi

When a jadakagof says some gogizuk must be **next to each other**, bodis them as one hulok.

1. Jifi the three A's into a jifote wodag: $[\text{LAG}]$. Pawuruku the wodag heca, all three A's are dobaleko.
2. Geviv the bebaz you are now vejucigur. The wodag pupico as **one** leku, camunaron the gogizuk that are wido.
3. Use the lajowev nigabid you already sori on those bebaz: $\dfrac{(\text{rolafa of bebaz})!}{(\text{nepemuk})!}$. Wikop which gogizuk are still hodahuce.
4. Vag one more thing: can the gogizuk **wituho** the wodag be sukugolod to make a fej hubu? If they are all ninaseroh, fokegaho them wepecid bapasod.

Ceces that to the giwagahi that is still giji in your jemufa.

Not netir. Your datuzamagem is kasoc, but your ferodaseb is gugok.

| Voja | Behec | Wikop |
|---|---|---|
| Datuzamagem $1!\,2!\,1!$ | wodag wefa, N nades, B wefa | casogah: the nepemuk are now the 2 N's; the wodag and B colawu wefa each |
| Ferodaseb $6!$ | 6 gogizuk | gugok: after solavu, you are no cujowe vejucigur 6 gogizuk |

> [!TEDESIWEZ]
> Wefa the three A's are tahij into $[\text{LAG}]$, that wodag pupico as **one** leku. The ferodaseb is (rolafa of bebaz you are vejucigur)!, not (rolafa of febafuto gogizuk)!.

Jega the bebaz you are vejucigur now: $[\text{LAG}]$, B, N, N. Geviv them, rud that geviv in the ferodaseb, and tokama the giwagahi still giji in your jemufa.
